caption:
फिल्म Ramayana में पति रवि दुबे की एक्टिंग देखकर सरगुन मेहता का दिल खुशी से झूम उठा है! 💖

रवि दुबे ने Nitesh Tiwari की फिल्म Ramayana: Rise of a Legend में भगवान राम बने Ranbir Kapoor के भाई लक्ष्मण का रोल निभाया है। ✨
इस पर सरगुन मेहता ने Instagram पर एक इमोशनल नोट शेयर कर रवि के 21 सालों के लंबे इंतजार, रिजेक्शंस और मेहनत को याद किया।
सरगुन ने लिखा कि इस दिवाली उनका 'वनवास' खत्म हुआ है और रवि की यह जीत उनके लिए एक पर्सनल जीत जैसी है। 🎬
उन्होंने रवि को अपना 'लाइट' बताते हुए कहा कि वो हमेशा से एक प्राउड वाइफ रही हैं, पर अब उनकी लाइफटाइम सबसे बड़ी फैन हैं।
बता दें कि इस फिल्म में Sai Pallavi, Yash और Sunny Deol भी हैं, जबकि म्यूजिक Hans Zimmer और AR Rahman का है।

क्या आप भी Ramayana में रवि दुबे को देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Sargun Mehta says she is biggest fan of husband Ravie Dubey after watching him as Lakshman in Ramayana, calls it a personal win
ctx.summary: Ravie Dubey is earning praise for his performance as Lakshman in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana.
ctx.text:
Ramayana Part 1, also titled Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, released in theatres in November 5. It stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Ravie Dubey as his brother, Lakshman. Ravie's performance has been receiving praise from viewers, and the actor's wife, Sargun Mehta, could not be more proud. She took to Instagram to pen a heartfelt note to cheer for Ravie and noted how he never complained about the years and years of hard work, and patiently waited for this day to arrive.
Sargun shared pictures of Ravie as Lakshman from the film, as well as snippets from the shoot in her post. She wrote a long caption along with it, noting how this Diwali their ‘vanvaas’ also came to an end with the release of Ramayana. Sargun added, “You knew this is in your heart all along .21 years of WAIT , of highs and lows , of rejections, of judgements , of barriers lost today to your faith and perseverance.” She revealed that Ravie always kept his heart to his work and never spoke ill of others even during the worst of times.
She said, "No matter who i meet and what i see on the internet today , your win feels like a personal win for everyone. Your win gives hope , your win makes me believe that Achchai ki jeet hoti hai (Good always wins). My heart is so full today as I know ki jo main kehti thi - ki "mera banda rabb hai" ab sab kahengey. (Now everyone will say that my guy is the real god). I am proud wife have always been but I am also your PROUDEST and BIGGEST FAN for life. You are my light badi . May you shine brighter , brightest . Thank you for making this diwali my brightest ever."
Ramayana marks Ravie's first major film in a pivotal role after a storied career on television spanning over a decade. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana, along with Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman.
Planned as a two-part saga, the film is inspired by the ancient epic Ramayana and follows the journey of Rama, believed to be an avatar of Lord Vishnu, from his life as the prince of Ayodhya and his exile to his battle against Ravana.
The music has been composed by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman. The first installment of Ramayana is scheduled to release in theatres during Diwali 2026, while the second part is expected to arrive during Diwali 2028.
